name: DOT Diagrams
changes: Set the width of one diagram with a line such as // width: 60%, // width: 480px or // width: natural.
// align: left, center or right moves a diagram. Two new settings give the default width and alignment.
tip: Add '// engine: neato' to a dot block to use a spring layout.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. DOT Diagrams is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
